children: Treasury yields fall in a week when market's mood sours, boosting demand for safe-haven investments. Hawkish Fedspeak underscores the prospect of higher borrowing costs, which damps optimism around AI expansion. Anthropic shares fizzle after yesterday's blockbuster IPO, joining Nvidia as a source of concern in equity markets. Next week brings a stream of data, including 3Q GDP and October PCE inflation, among other indicators, ahead of Thanksgiving. The Treasury will auction two-, five- and seven-year notes. The 10-year yield falls 0.244 percentage point this week, to 4.909%. The two-year slips 0.261 point, its largest one-week decline since September 2024, to 4.611%.
